_doc: D4 (MIGRATION-PLAN §3s): the Main copy. Seventeen data nodes change; every one receives a single item, so all keep the default `single` batching (Q18 covers only the four multi-item writes). Upserts SET exactly the columns the Airtable node mapped, `created_at` included (D4-4). `Record Processed` stays DO NOTHING (Q17). The one webhook moves to a test path behind Access; both lanes (widget, whatsapp) move with it. `availableInMCP` and `binaryMode` are created ABSENT on the copy (D4-1).
name: MIG COPY — Main

binaryMode.ruling: MIGRATION-PLAN §3r settings-parity (O1, 2026-10-22): the public API ignores binaryMode on create and update; every reader at the running build's source tag treats an absent binaryMode as "separate"

availableInMCP.ruling: MIGRATION-PLAN §3r MCP exposure (2026-10-22) and D4-1 (2026-10-23): a copy's absent availableInMCP is false, i.e. narrower than Main's accepted exposure; the deploy helper strips it from the request

Save State.query: INSERT INTO salon.conversations (sender_key, stage, turn_count, last_updated, last_intent, slot_service, slot_date, slot_time, gcal_event_id, cancel_target_id, confirm_turn, computed_reply, recent_messages) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::timestamptz, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, $10, $11, $12, $13) ON CONFLICT (sender_key) DO UPDATE SET stage = EXCLUDED.stage, turn_count = EXCLUDED.turn_count, last_updated = EXCLUDED.last_updated, last_intent = EXCLUDED.last_intent, slot_service = EXCLUDED.slot_service, slot_date = EXCLUDED.slot_date, slot_time = EXCLUDED.slot_time, gcal_event_id = EXCLUDED.gcal_event_id, cancel_target_id = EXCLUDED.cancel_target_id, confirm_turn = EXCLUDED.confirm_turn, computed_reply = EXCLUDED.computed_reply, recent_messages = EXCLUDED.recent_messages RETURNING @@shape(conversations)@@

Capture Lead.query: INSERT INTO salon.leads (name, phone, source, message, status, created_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'new', $5::timestamptz) RETURNING @@shape(leads)@@

Write Appointment.query: INSERT INTO salon.appointments (sender_key, service, start_utc, end_utc, gcal_event_id, channel, customer_name, status, created_at, calendar_id) VALUES ($1, $2, $3::timestamptz, $4::timestamptz, $5, $6, $7, 'booked', $8::timestamptz, $9) ON CONFLICT (gcal_event_id) DO UPDATE SET sender_key = EXCLUDED.sender_key, service = EXCLUDED.service, start_utc = EXCLUDED.start_utc, end_utc = EXCLUDED.end_utc, channel = EXCLUDED.channel, customer_name = EXCLUDED.customer_name, status = EXCLUDED.status, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, calendar_id = EXCLUDED.calendar_id RETURNING @@shape(appointments)@@

Record Processed.query: INSERT INTO salon.processed_messages (message_id, sender_key, channel, created_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::timestamptz) ON CONFLICT (message_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING @@shape(processed_messages)@@

Save State (Post-Write).query: INSERT INTO salon.conversations (sender_key, stage, turn_count, last_updated, last_intent, slot_service, slot_date, slot_time, gcal_event_id, cancel_target_id, confirm_turn, computed_reply, recent_messages) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::timestamptz, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, $10, $11, $12, $13) ON CONFLICT (sender_key) DO UPDATE SET stage = EXCLUDED.stage, turn_count = EXCLUDED.turn_count, last_updated = EXCLUDED.last_updated, last_intent = EXCLUDED.last_intent, slot_service = EXCLUDED.slot_service, slot_date = EXCLUDED.slot_date, slot_time = EXCLUDED.slot_time, gcal_event_id = EXCLUDED.gcal_event_id, cancel_target_id = EXCLUDED.cancel_target_id, confirm_turn = EXCLUDED.confirm_turn, computed_reply = EXCLUDED.computed_reply, recent_messages = EXCLUDED.recent_messages RETURNING @@shape(conversations)@@

Find Booking.query: SELECT @@shape(appointments)@@ FROM salon.appointments WHERE sender_key = $1 AND status = 'booked' ORDER BY created_at, id

Update Appointment Cancelled.query: UPDATE salon.appointments SET status = 'cancelled' WHERE id = $1 RETURNING @@shape(appointments)@@

Find Booking (Reschedule).query: SELECT @@shape(appointments)@@ FROM salon.appointments WHERE sender_key = $1 AND status = 'booked' ORDER BY created_at, id

Find Old Booking (Reschedule).query: SELECT @@shape(appointments)@@ FROM salon.appointments WHERE sender_key = $1 AND status = 'booked' ORDER BY created_at, id

Update Appointment (Reschedule).query: UPDATE salon.appointments SET gcal_event_id = $2, start_utc = $3::timestamptz, end_utc = $4::timestamptz, calendar_id = $5, reminded = false WHERE id = $1 RETURNING @@shape(appointments)@@

Record LLM Spend.query: INSERT INTO salon.bot_metrics (period_key, cost_usd, updated_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3::timestamptz) ON CONFLICT (period_key) DO UPDATE SET cost_usd = EXCLUDED.cost_usd, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at RETURNING @@shape(bot_metrics)@@

Record Alert Class.query: UPDATE salon.conversations SET last_alert_class = $2, last_alert_at = $3::timestamptz WHERE id = $1 RETURNING @@shape(conversations)@@
